Chemical Plus Weekly Service | Skim n' Dip, LLC
text: P: Weekly Service to ensure your pool is safe and clean.

P: Chemical Plus is the service package we offer. This package includes brushing the walls and stairs, skimming the waters surface, balancing the chlorine, pH, and alkalinity, emptying the skimmer basket, emptying the sweep bag or basket, and inspecting the pool equipment on a weekly basis. The cost of chemicals to balance the chlorine, pH, and alkalinity is included with the cost of service. Any additional chemicals needed to balance other chemical levels outside these three such as Salt, Phosphate/ Algae treatments, etc will require additional costs and testing. This package does not include bottom cleaning because most pools have sweeps that clean the bottom. If you do not have a sweep we offer vacuuming as an individual service that we charge separately for. Also, we will clean the filters every 4 months to ensure the pool is circulating properly and filtering as it should.

text: P: Need a fix? We'll fix it fast!

text: P: Get your Pool or Spa sparkling again.

P: Green Pool? Dirty Pool? You name it, we can clean it. We offer several different one time cleaning services for your pool and/or spa ranging from Filter Cleanings, Vacuuming the Pool floor, Spa Water Swaps, and Green Pool Cleanings, we do it all.

text: P: Get the most out of your pool.

Give us a call to discuss options that could save you $$! There are several upgrades we can do to your pool to increase it's cleanliness and ensure it is safe to use. Give us call for a free quote.
